content: शून्य {%a.%} [शूनायै प्राणिवधाय हितं रहस्यस्थानत्वात् यत् <ls>Tv.</ls>] .²1 Empty, void. .²2 Vacant (applied also to the heart, glances <ab>&c.</ab>), absent, listless; गमनमलसं शून्या दृष्टिः <ls>Māl. 1. 17</ls>; see शून्यहृदय below. .²3 Non-existent. .²4 Lonely, desolate, secluded, deserted; शून्येषु शूरा न के <ls>K. P. 7</ls>; <ls>Bk. 6. 9</ls>; शून्यं मन्ये जगदविरतज्वालमन्तर्ज्वलामि <ls>U. 3. 38</ls>; <ls>Māl. 9. 20</ls>. .²5 Dejected, downcast, dispirited; शून्या जगाम भवनाभिमुखी कथंचित् <ls>Ku. 3. 75</ls>; <ls>Ki. 17. 39</ls>. .²6 Utterly devoid or deprived of, without, wanting in (with <ab>instr.</ab> or in <ab>comp.</ab>); अङ्गुलीयकशून्या मे अङ्गुलिः <ls>Ś. 5</ls>; दया˚, ज्ञान˚, <ab>&c.</ab> .²7 Indifferent. .²8 Guileless. .²9 Nonsensical, unmeaning; मुहुरविशदवर्णां निद्रया शून्यशून्याम् <ls>Śi. 11. 4</ls>. .²10 Bare, naked. .{@-न्यम्@} .²1 A vacuum, void, blank. .²2 The sky, space, atmosphere. .²3 A cipher, dot. .²4 Non-entity, (absolute) non-existence; दूषणशून्यबिन्दवः <ls>N. 1. 21</ls>. .²5 <ab>N.</ab> of Brahman. .²6 An earring; शून्यकर्णः <ls>Amaru.</ls>
